payload.text: ST0001 ubuntu CI (vc, run 41591508539 at 92105af): macOS is all green, bats included, but ubuntu fails 3 replay cases, sync-apply-plan, sync-link-all-names and sync-link-apply, each with a bare 'No such file or directory (os error 2)'. The two sync tests print Os { code: 2 }, so it is a ? in the harness, not pplr's output. It is not the sidecar (the replay sets PPLR_CONTACTS_JSON) and not xlsx-cells (sync-plan checks a workbook too and passes there); every manifest file has an exact-name golden. All three write links and a (Contacts).inetloc. Find the real ENOENT, then fix under AC-00.7 as its own small measured commit, first-ready against cc's WP11 commit 3 (both touch tests/cli.rs). Then expect the bats layer (todo 1)
